title_zh: 阿格里帕作为陪衬形象
description_en: Modern popular perception sometimes reduces Agrippa to 'Augustus' friend' or a supporting character. Ancient evidence shows he was a major independent military commander and administrator whose achievements were recognized in his own right. His early death may have limited later historiographical attention.
description_zh: 现代流行认知有时将阿格里帕简化为“奥古斯都的朋友”或配角。古典文献表明他是具有重大独立贡献的军事指挥官和行政官，其成就在生前即获得认可。其早逝可能限制了后世史家的关注度。
